BLACKCORE PROTOCOLS

LAST REVISION: JANUARY 1, 2025

CORE DIRECTIVE

"We must be better. For them."

COMMUNICATION

  • Clear, concise callouts during operations. No mic spam.
  • Acknowledge IGL commands instantly.
  • Maintain radio silence in clutch situations.

PRACTICE PROTOCOLS

  • Punctuality is mandatory for scheduled scrims.
  • Warm-up required before official sessions begin.
  • Review VODs and analyze performance objectively.

TOURNAMENT ENGAGEMENT

  • Loadouts must be optimized and verified prior to bracket start.
  • Follow organizer rules strictly to avoid penalties.
  • Maintain composure regardless of score deficit.

BEHAVIORAL STANDARDS

  • Toxicity towards teammates or opponents is grounds for removal.
  • Represent the BlackCore insignia with honor.
  • Constructive criticism only. Egos checked at the door.
